remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated single-story home in one of South Huntington Beach’s most desirable neighborhoods. Designed for comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, the open-concept floor plan offers expanded living space and a seamless flow throughout. The main living areas connect beautifully to the private backyard, creating an ideal indoor-outdoor setting for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the Southern California lifestyle. At the heart of the home is a chef’s kitchen featuring a six-burner gas range with professional-style hood, generous counter space, and plenty of room for gathering with family and friends.
